rec.name: Cart Shipping Cost Communication (Subtotal / Shipping / Total)
rec.status: Built — launched (approved by 3 testers; v1.1 coupling idea open)

what.text: A cart footer price breakdown for the cart drawer and cart page with three rows: Subtotal, Shipping and Total. The shipping row shows the shipping fee, or a highlighted 'Free' label (custom text, colour and bold) once the free-shipping threshold is reached. Optionally the shipping row shows a country dropdown (e.g. 'Shipping costs: Germany ▾') with live shipping rates taken from the Shopify shipping zones. If the dropdown is switched off, one global shipping fee is shown.

why.text: Showing shipping costs early and transparently removes the surprise-cost shock that causes cart abandonment. A green, bold 'Free' label turns free shipping into a visible reward. A per-country shipping estimate gives international buyers certainty before checkout, which builds trust and reduces risk.

how.text: Add the settings to settings_schema.json (calculation on/off, free-shipping threshold, delivery fee, live-calculation checkbox, footer labels, free-text colour). Create the snippet totals-cart.liquid, which computes the shipping price (0 if cart total >= threshold) and renders the Subtotal, Shipping and Total rows. Render it in mini-cart.liquid before the checkout button, and on the cart page. For the optional country dropdown, add a mini-shipping-estimator custom element in theme.js. It calls Shopify's /cart/prepare_shipping_rates.json and /cart/async_shipping_rates.json with country and zip, stores the choice in cookies, and uses the country-with-province-zip snippet for default zip codes. The free-shipping threshold must also match Shopify Settings > Shipping. The code is based on a theme with a 'mini-cart' and a 'themeVariables' object.

items: Free shipping minimum amount (supports multi-currency, e.g. USD:50,EUR:60)
Delivery fee (plain number, not in cents)
Enable live shipping calculation / country dropdown (checkbox)
Free shipping text colour (default #007600), always bold
Design variants (hnds.de style and signsofbeautyshop.com style)

dependencies.text: No product metafields needed. Shipping rates for the dropdown come from Shopify shipping zones (backend), not from the theme. The free-shipping threshold must be kept identical in the theme settings and in Shopify Settings > Shipping. Requires cart drawer and cart page templates, theme.js and settings_schema.json access. Hard-coded German strings in the JS (error messages, 'Kostenlos') need localisation for other languages. The free-shipping row is not yet linked to the progress bar (known issue).

items: Conversion rate by country (if dropdown is on)
